title: How to send messages and reply in threads
summary: Post in a channel, and keep side-conversations tidy with threads.

blocks.heading: Messages and threads
paragraphs: Type in the box at the bottom of a channel and press Cmd/Ctrl + Enter (or the send arrow) to post. To keep a side-conversation out of the main flow, open a thread on a message and reply there.
Hover a message to reveal its actions, including “Reply in thread”. Messages that already have replies show a “View thread” link.
